title: Wisdom & Discernment
intro: It seems early to pray for wisdom over someone who cannot sit up. It is not. Wisdom starts as trust, and trust is built in the first year — in whether the world answers, whether faces are safe, whether the same voice comes back. This month prays forward, over a life that will need it.

keyScriptures.text: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

weeks.title: Wisdom Begins as Trust
weeks.declaration: Long before you can think anything through, you are learning whether the world can be trusted. That is where wisdom starts.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, build trust in this child through us. Let us be worth trusting. Amen.

weeks.title: You Will Be Given What You Need
weeks.declaration: You will not have to work life out alone. Wisdom is given to those who ask, and you will learn to ask.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, give us wisdom for the decisions we are making over this child now, before they can have any say. Amen.

weeks.title: Learning by Watching
weeks.declaration: You are already learning by watching. What you see in us is your first lesson in how to live.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make us worth copying. Where we are not, protect this child from learning it. Amen.

weeks.title: Growing in Wisdom
weeks.declaration: You will grow in wisdom the way you are growing now — slowly, daily, without noticing.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, grow this child in wisdom all their life. Start now, in ways we cannot see. Amen.

days.title: Wisdom Is Given
days.declaration: Wisdom is not something you must invent. It is given, and the giving has already started.

scripture.text: The Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

days.title: Learning to Trust
days.declaration: You are learning that the world answers when you call. Everything sensible is built on that.

scripture.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart.

days.title: Growing Slowly
days.declaration: You are growing in wisdom the way you are growing in everything: slowly, and without noticing.

scripture.text: Jesus grew in wisdom and stature.

days.title: Watching Us
days.declaration: You are learning by watching. What you see is your first lesson in how a person lives.

scripture.text: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

days.title: You May Always Ask
days.declaration: You will never be too old or too young to ask. Asking is what wise people do.

scripture.text: Ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.

days.title: A Lamp for Later
days.declaration: There will be a light for every step you take, and it will always be enough for the next one.

scripture.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

days.title: Not Left to Guess
days.declaration: You will not be left to guess your way through life. You will be guided.

scripture.text: This is the way; walk in it.

days.title: Sense and Kindness Together
days.declaration: May you be sensible and kind at once. The best wisdom leaves people better.

scripture.text: The wisdom from above is first pure, then peace-loving, considerate.

days.title: Safe Voices
days.declaration: May the voices you trust be worth trusting. May you learn early which they are.

scripture.text: Walk with the wise and become wise.

days.title: Knowing When to Wait
days.declaration: May you learn to wait, which is most of wisdom and almost none of instinct.

scripture.text: Wait for the Lord; be strong and take heart.

days.title: A Discerning Heart
days.declaration: May you have a discerning heart — one that can tell good from nearly-good.

scripture.text: Give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people.

days.title: Learning from Small Things
days.declaration: You will learn from small things first: a spoon, a step, a word. Nothing is beneath learning.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Curiosity Is a Gift
days.declaration: Your curiosity is a gift, not a nuisance. May nobody ever talk you out of it.

scripture.text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge.

days.title: Correctable
days.declaration: May you always be someone who can be corrected. That one quality will carry you far.

scripture.text: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still.

days.title: Honest with Yourself
days.declaration: May you be honest with yourself, which is harder and more useful than being clever.

scripture.text: You desired faithfulness even in the womb.

days.title: Not Fooled by Loud
days.declaration: May you never mistake the loudest voice for the truest one.

scripture.text: The first to present a case seems right, till another comes forward.

days.title: Time to Think
days.declaration: May you always be given a moment to think, and may you learn to take it.

scripture.text: Do you see someone who speaks in haste?

days.title: Wisdom in Your Hands
days.declaration: One day you will make decisions we cannot make for you. May you be ready.

scripture.text: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet.

days.title: Sleep and Sense
days.declaration: Even now, rest is making you able to learn. That will be true your whole life.

scripture.text: He grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Learning the Word
days.declaration: May the words we read over you now be there when you need them decades from now.

scripture.text: I have hidden your word in my heart.

days.title: Fear of the Lord
days.declaration: May you grow up knowing God is God. Everything sensible starts there.

scripture.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

days.title: Slow to Speak
days.declaration: May you be quick to listen and slow to speak. It is rare and it is worth having.

scripture.text: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak.

days.title: Thinking of the End
days.declaration: May you learn to look one step further than you need to.

scripture.text: The prudent give thought to their steps.

days.title: Guided When We Cannot
days.declaration: There will be rooms we are not in. May you be guided there too.

scripture.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go.

days.title: Wise About People
days.declaration: May you read people kindly and accurately, and know the difference between the two.

scripture.text: Be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

days.title: Failing and Learning
days.declaration: You will get things wrong. May you learn from it rather than hide it.

scripture.text: Listen to advice and accept discipline.

days.title: Peace in Deciding
days.declaration: May you make decisions without fear, knowing you are held whichever way it goes.

scripture.text: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast.

days.title: Wisdom Over Cleverness
days.declaration: May you be wise rather than merely clever, if you ever have to choose.

scripture.text: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom.

days.title: Asking Again
days.declaration: May you never feel foolish for asking twice. God does not tire of the question.

scripture.text: Ask and it will be given to you.

days.title: A Lifetime of Growing
days.declaration: Wisdom will keep growing in you as long as you keep asking. There is no ceiling.

scripture.text: Let the wise listen and add to their learning.

days.title: Ours to Pray Now
days.declaration: We are praying wisdom over you before you can want it. It will be here when you do.

scripture.text: We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will.
